instruction.text: Choose the inverse sum that could be used to check the calculation.
Jaden works out the sum below in his workbook. Build an inverse sum to double check Jaden’s answer.

hint.text: An inverse sum is the opposite to what operation has already been done. Just flip the sum around: 161 − 63 or 161 − 98.

end.text: Jaden’s answer is correct, because the inverse sum gave us the same values as in the original calculation.

instruction.text: Orla wants to add her birthday money together. She got £45 from her Aunt and £110 from her grandparents. She says she has £145 altogether. Build an inverse sum to check Orla’s answer.

hint.text: The inverse sum is the opposite to what operation has already been done. Just flip the sum around.

instruction.text: Find the answer to the inverse sum to check Orla’s answer.

end.text: Orla’s answer is not correct, because the inverse sum has given us a value that was not in the original sum.

instruction.text: Calculate how much birthday money Orla has altogether.
